item_short_desc: Rothco’s camouflage spray paint matches federal specifications, offering a durable finish that is resistant to corrosion and abrasion. This paint will not chip or peel under tough outdoor conditions. The fast drying formula is ideal for military vehicle restoration when blended to U.S. Military color patterns, and is great for either outdoor or DIY projects. The spray paint comes in a 16-oz. (12-oz. Fill) aerosol can. Note: Shipping restrictions apply.
